text: Free co-op demo: up to eight friends, one raft, and a river that wants you dead.
You paddle together, steer through the rapids, and try not to go over the waterfall.
You will go over the waterfall.
Best moment in the trailer: a whole raft wedged sideways on the rocks while everyone flails.
Off the river, there are puzzles, campfires, bears at night, and a deer that gets hit by lightning.
The catch? On land, the running animations look stiff.
The demo is about one point four gigs, in nineteen languages.
Think Human Fall Flat, on a whitewater raft.
Worth a dip with friends who can't row in time.
